summary: Verified iteration 865 backlog fixes: (a) entitlement/access-control regression sweep across 12 suites = 219/219 passed, (b) OTP bypass allowlist for 3 accounts works (no requires_2fa on login), (c) idempotent seed script produces same output on 2nd run with password preserved, (d) certificate engagement per-IP rate limit gives exactly 30x200 + 5x429 in burst and window resets after 60s, (e) free user 200 on /api/ai-access/status and /api/ai-access/tier-comparison, unauth still 401, /api/bill-generator/bootstrap still 403 for free (access engine intact), (f) frontend /dashboard, /profile, /certificate-verify/... all 200 (no more 500 from corrupted TSX generic).
critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiter for certificate_engagement is in-process (Python dict) — will not enforce across multiple Uvicorn workers or after restarts. If backend scales horizontally, move to Redis-backed counters (/app/backend/utils/api_rate_limiter_redis.py pattern already exists in codebase).

TvFree seed script prints 'updated existing user ... (password preserved: True)' even when nothing meaningful changes — consider a no-op fast path or logging when password IS rehashed vs preserved to avoid noise in logs.

The corrupted-TSX regression (JSX prop injected into a TS generic) suggests a pre-commit / CI lint gap for .tsx files feeding the static-export self-heal. Consider adding `tsc --noEmit` on the two components touched in a CI stage to fail fast next time.
seed_data_creation: Re-ran /app/backend/scripts/seed_tv_free_test_user.py twice; both runs printed 'updated existing user user_8b0d21552d5b (password preserved: True)' — confirming idempotency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The certificate_engagement rate limiter is in-memory (per-process). Running the burst test consumes the 30-req window; wait 60s before further engagement calls or backend restart. Use X-Client-Platform: native header on POST /api/auth/login to receive session_token/refresh_token in body (cookie-only auth works without). Login response key is 'session_token' (not 'access_token' or 'token').
rca of the issue: N/A — verification-only pass. All root-cause fixes claimed by main agent (OTP allowlist, seed script, access_control_engine FREE_PATTERNS, public_rate_limits certificate_engagement rule, corrupted TSX repair) are confirmed to have landed and behave as specified.
